steps: 1. Enter HUD edit mode with `/edit_hud` or **Enter HUD Edit Mode**. Inspect boxes before dragging.
2. Include pivot-based **Buffs** or **Boss Health**, panel-based **Equipment**, plus representative text, icon and composite elements.
3. Drag toward every screen edge at two available resolutions or UI scales. Compare each hit/drag box with the visible element and its edge stop.
4. Save, exit edit mode, reopen it and compare saved positions; inspect an untouched element as a control.
assertions: Hit areas and boxes surround actual rendered bounds, edge confinement uses those visible bounds, saved positions round-trip and untouched elements do not shift. Attach screenshots if any offset remains.
hud_drag_geometry_uses_render_bounds PASS; per element compare drag_geometry rect with the widget's scenegraph world rect at two UI scales; edge clamp.
